title: The Inventory of Anderlecht
author: Ada Sandoval
blurb: Sable Halloran, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
